speaker: Townsperson
original_en:
Why did King Barbarossa have to
suffer the wrath of the gods? <PART>
---
Couldn't the gods at least show
some mercy to the queen?
original_jp: なぜバルバロッサ様が神の〓めを受けなければならないのでしょう？ <PART> このままでは王妃様まで…神には〓悲も何もないのでしょうか…

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_en:
It was all so sudden... Tens of soldiers
wiped out by one lone warrior.
original_jp: 本当に一瞬の出来事だったんだ何十人も居た兵が たった一人の戦士に…

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_en:
So the king was...executed...
It's over...for Dipan...
original_jp: 王は…処刑されたのか……ディパンは…滅ぶのだな…

speaker: Townsperson
original_en:
Forsaken by the gods we worshipped.
Who are we to pray to now?
original_jp: 祈るべき神に見捨てられた私達はこれから何に祈りを〓げれば良いのですか…

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_en:
Hundreds of years building our culture,
all gone in a flash. What was this for?
original_jp: 何百年と続いた栄〓も 滅び去るのは一瞬だな…我らは 何のために今まで…

speaker: Townsperson
original_en:
Say, aren't you...yes, Princess Alicia!
Please, tell us... What should we do?
original_jp: アリーシャ王女…なのですよね？私達は…これからどうすれば良いのでしょうか…
